emails.subject_summary: Officer in charge; bail conditions; evidence request; NICE link offer
emails.body:
Hi Ben
I am the officer in charge for your case with Sussex Police, ref 47240214305
To update you, the suspect was interviewed (they denied the allegation). They have been released with conditions not
to contact you directly or indirectly and not to go to your address. Obviously, this works both ways so please refrain
from contacting her as well.
I will update you as the case progresses, but for the next month or two at least we will be awaiting results of the
suspect’s seized mobile phone examination.
I contacted you and left a voicemail earlier in regard to yourself sending across evidence that had been requested by
attending officers. Can you confirm you can still do this and then I can send a NICE upload link across to you.
Regards
PC DIXON
EA817

That being someone's reality and outlook is so surreal that I have no idea what she will do or is capable of doing.

emails.subject_summary: Bail confirmation and Norfolk Constabulary forwarded message re: Paul Double
emails.body:
Hi Ben
It’s understandable to have concerns and worries, if you need additional support let me know and I can make referrals.
As per our conversation yesterday I can confirm that Alanna is still on bail. This was what is called Initial Bail to start with but as of 2 Feb 2025 this bail period has been extended till 4 May 2025. The conditions to not contact you or attend your address remain the same, if she sees you in the street or at a venue for example she must make all reasonable effort to leave as soon as she becomes aware. The bail conditions apply to you as you are the victim and will remain as such while the investigation is ongoing.
I hope that this answers your query.

emails.subject_summary: Paul DOUBLE – registered sex offender, breaches notification requirements
emails.body:
Thank you for your help with this. DOUBLE is a registered sex offender and subject to the Sex offenders registration conditions, one of which is weekly registration as he is NFA.
DOUBLE has breached this on 2 occasions:
1. Failed to register by 25/1/2025.
2. Had not stayed at his mother’s since 7 Dec 2024, confirmed living NFA in Great Yarmouth but did not register.

We are happy for you to bail him or release him under investigation and PR later. If released, please ensure he registers immediately at a designated police station. His mother does not want him at her address.

Attachments included: Interview Plan, Sex Offender Requirements, prior email.
